data.one_liner: A Flutter widget that provides a dropdown or dialog select field integrated with Form APIs.
data.what_it_does: SelectFormField extends TextFormField to display a list of selectable options in a dropdown or dialog. It returns the selected value as a string via onChanged, validator, and onSaved callbacks.
use_when: You need a simple select input inside a Flutter Form
You want a dropdown or dialog picker without writing custom logic
You require support for icons, custom text styles, and disabled items
avoid_when: You need multi‑select or complex searchable lists
You require advanced theming beyond basic TextStyle overrides
You need platform‑specific picker dialogs (iOS picker, Android spinner)
strengths: Easy to drop into existing Form widgets
Supports icons, custom text styles, and disabled items
Works on all Flutter platforms (mobile, web, desktop)
weaknesses: No built‑in search or multi‑select capabilities
Styling is basic; deep customization may require fork
